title: Paloma and the Summer
author: Astrid Halloran
blurb: Felix Nakamura, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
